metadata.case_name: MOHAMMAD WAHEED KHAN v. RISING SUN TRANSPORTATION COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: salesman for Fletcher Jon’s Custom Tailors

injuries.description: sprained lower back / soft tissue sprain injury to the Plaintiff’s lower back
source: On examination, the Plaintiff was found to suffer from sprained lower back.

Both doctors opined that the injury was compatible with the Plaintiff’s description of the circumstances of the accident on 23 September 2006. They agreed that accident had caused soft tissue sprain injury to the Plaintiff’s lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: mild posterior central intervertebral disc bulging between the 4th and 5th lumbar spine level
source: MRI in August 2007 revealed that there was mild posterior central intervertebral disc bulging between the 4th and 5th lumbar spine level.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: residual back pain during daily activities (sleeping, taking shower, sitting on toilet, sexual intercourse, walking, dressing and in cold weather).
mild tenderness over midline upper lumbar region and sacrum; moderate tenderness over midline lumbo-sacral junction; mild tenderness bilateral paraspinal muscles at lumbo-sacral junction.
all trunk movements were limited by severe pain; slightly reduced active movement
reduced straight-leg-raising on lying but satisfactory on sitting; restrictions on straight leg raising both sides

treatments_received: attendance at Accident & Emergency Department of Ruttonjee & Tang Shiu Kin Hospitals
attendance at Accident & Emergency Department of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital

losses.description: Residual impairment and pain of the lower back causing reduced function of the lumbar spine.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Pain affecting daily activities such as taking shower, sitting on toilet, dressing.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Residual back pain experienced during sexual intercourse.
Mild to moderate impairment as a delivery worker; unsuitable for manual labour requiring lifting and repeated bending, limiting employment options to driving or light-duty work.
